note: Tracked review spec for the Phase 3 source-level review packet (execution plan §3 item 5). Holds reviewer judgments and references only. Source sections and saved responses are resolved by scripts/recommendations_live/review_packet.py into ignored files under evals/results/phase3_review/. Historical observations come from saved artifacts; current-policy expectations describe the code at the close-out pass. No candidate set is reconstructed from a new search.
attribution: AI-assisted review; pending owner acceptance; not independently human-verified or culinarily validated.

contract_versions.phase3-free-text-v1: run5 code state (2026-09-24): server-issued candidate labels, deterministic validation, server-rendered recipe, free-text selection_reasons/needs (superseded by repair pass 4). Offered candidate identities were not recorded.
contract_versions.phase3-typed-v2: Repair pass 4 (2026-09-24): typed propositions with server wording, rejected_propositions, repaired native-tool continuation, evidence snapshot fingerprints, offered_candidates diagnostics.
contract_versions.phase3-closeout: Close-out pass (2026-09-24): adds response-only source_checks on recommendations and ready_to_cook/why/source_defects on discovery pointers. Provider contract and continuation unchanged.

examples.title: Useful ordinary recommendation (historical contract)
not_recorded: Offered candidate identities and titles (3 offered; only counts were saved).
Exact provider request body (a dry run saved only its byte count and hash).
Clarification state beyond the case inputs and the saved revisions.

execution.rationale: 200 recommendation; 1 provider call; 1758 input / 142 output / 0 reasoning tokens; $0.0001447 from actual usage.

fidelity.rationale: Rendered ingredients and steps equal the stored source (runner refetch and builder re-render).

usefulness.rationale: A chicken curry with a reported 33-minute total. Every quantity is a bare number with no unit (for example nam pla "3"), so the cook must guess amounts. The source spells "cocnut milk" in step 0.

constraint_support.rationale: time_limit supported only as source-reported (33 <= 40). The historical free-text reason "within ~40 min" restated the user's limit instead of the source figure.

defects: Historical contract: free-text reasons paraphrased the time limit, and the need "Any ingredient restrictions to consider?" invited a dietary check the backend cannot perform.
Source: no units for any quantity.
unknowns: Whether "clove 1/4" means whole or ground cloves.

expected_backend_behavior.current_policy: Same source stays admissible (no recorded defect); amounts render as unknown with the source quantity text; only typed propositions are published, and a time reason quotes the source's 33 minutes.

examples.title: Repaired native-tool recommendation
not_recorded: Reasoning item content, summaries and encrypted content (never requested or stored by design; only item ids).
Full provider request bodies (sizes and item kinds only).

execution.rationale: 2 turns, 1 native get_recipe call; turn 2 sent the final-selection system item, the retained user message, the reasoning item, and the function_call and function_call_output with the same call_id; no tools offered; 7525 of 12000 chars. Usage 313/33 and 1344/99 tokens; $0.00013565 actual.

fidelity.rationale: The fetched source matched the evidence snapshot fingerprint; the rendered recipe equals the stored source.

usefulness.rationale: Same source as PX-01: a Thai chicken curry within the reported time, with the same missing-units caveat.

constraint_support.rationale: time_limit supported as source-reported (33 <= 40). The only published reason, dish_named_in_title, is true and server-worded.

defects: Source: no units for any quantity (see PX-01).

expected_backend_behavior.current_policy: Unchanged by the close-out pass (provider contract and continuation untouched); the response now also carries source_checks.

examples.title: FOLLOWUP-01: presentable source with an inconsistent ingredient list
not_recorded: The ingredient refs the model cited for the rejected uses_listed_ingredients reason (rejections keep kind/index/type/code only).

fidelity.rationale: Rendered recipe equals the stored source; evidence fingerprint equals the current re-build.

usefulness.rationale: No listed ingredient has a quantity (the raw quantity list has 9 values for 6 names, so none were assigned). Steps 1-3 use potatoes, oil and water, which the ingredient list omits. The offered 000250 was the better choice, so this is a selection weakness, not a retrieval gap.

constraint_support.rationale: time_limit supported as source-reported (20 <= 40). Published reasons (dish_named_in_title, reported_time_within_limit) are true; no unsupported claim.

defects: Source inconsistency: steps use potatoes, oil and water that the ingredient list omits. The stored row records no defect, so nothing blocks it.
Selection quality: a weaker source was chosen over an offered better one.
Diagnostics: rejected propositions do not keep the cited refs.
unknowns: Amounts of potatoes and oil, and the oil type.
Which raw quantity value belongs to which ingredient.

expected_backend_behavior.current_policy: Still presentable today: the stored row carries no machine-readable defect and no automatic detection exists. The response now says so (source_checks.ingredient_list_vs_steps = not_checked). If ENR-03 were accepted and recorded on the row (a separate, authorized data change), the existing gate would keep it out of model evidence and show it only as a discovery pointer (why = blocking source defect). That gate is demonstrated with an isolated fixture only.

examples.title: Partial quantities, ranges and parse-mangled names
not_recorded: Offered candidate identities (3 retrieved, 2 offered, 1 dropped for budget; only counts were saved).

execution.rationale: 200 recommendation; 1 provider call; 2175/210/0 tokens; $0.00019275 actual. The injected pantry text did not reach any recipe field.

fidelity.rationale: Rendered recipe equals the stored source, including the parse-mangled canonical names next to intact original lines.

usefulness.rationale: A chicken curry, but the steps need a slow cooker and 3-4 hours on high or 6-7 on low. Servings and total time are unknown, several amounts are ranges kept as text, and several stored names are mangled ("- cup coconut milk").

constraint_support.rationale: No enforced constraint was requested and nothing was presented as satisfied. The historical free-text need "slow cooker vs stovetop" implied an adaptation the source does not have.

defects: Stored data: canonical names include quantity fragments (ing-9, ing-14, ing-15, ing-16) or leading qualifiers (ing-1, ing-3).
Historical contract: a free-text need implied an unsupported adaptation.

expected_backend_behavior.current_policy: Admissible (info-level quantity_range issues are context, not blocks); typed propositions cannot imply adaptations; the slow-cooker requirement is not checked (equipment is not_applicable).

examples.title: Dietary-constrained abstention
not_recorded: The identity of the retrieved source: insufficient-evidence constraint verdicts carry no candidate identity, and violated sources are not listed as discovery pointers.
Retrieved candidate count (not included in insufficient-evidence responses; the saved verdicts imply exactly one assessed source).

execution.rationale: 200 insufficient_evidence (hard_constraint_unresolved) with zero provider calls and $0.

usefulness.rationale: Abstaining is correct for an unverifiable vegan request. No discovery pointer was offered, because the only assessed source was violated.

constraint_support.rationale: dietary:vegan was violated by keyword ("honey mustard" contains "honey") and never presented as satisfied. The reason code hard_constraint_unresolved also covers the all-violated case; the detail says "violated or unverified".

defects: Diagnostics: the violated source's identity is not recorded on the insufficient-evidence path.
unknowns: Which source was retrieved and assessed.
Whether a keyword-clean tofu source exists in the corpus; this run exercised the violated branch, not the unresolved branch.

expected_backend_behavior.current_policy: Same outcome. A keyword-clean candidate would be unresolved and also abstain; dietary requests abstain until verified dietary evidence exists.

examples.title: Relevance/usefulness failure: "toast"
not_recorded: Offered candidate identities (3 offered; only counts were saved), so a retrieval gap cannot be told apart from a selection error.

execution.rationale: 200 recommendation; 1 provider call; 2189/165/0 tokens; $0.00017545 actual; Epicure recorded simple_technique_skip.

fidelity.rationale: Rendered recipe equals the stored source, including a stray final step "Allrecipes" (a source artifact).

usefulness.rationale: The user asked for toast and got a French toast casserole that needs 8 hours to overnight refrigeration plus about 30 minutes baking. Servings and total time are unknown.

constraint_support.rationale: No constraint was requested. The historical free-text reason called it "simple" and the need offered "a shorter version", a capability that does not exist.

defects: Stored data: a non-instruction step ("Allrecipes") renders as step-8.
Usefulness gap of unknown cause (retrieval vs selection).

expected_backend_behavior.current_policy: Typed propositions prevent the "simple"/"shorter version" claims; the stray step still renders (no source screening); selection and retrieval quality are unchanged (future work). New runs record offered candidates, so a repeat would be diagnosable.
